name: University of Notre Dame
character: The 1,250-acre suburban campus features greenery, two lakes, seven quadrangles, athletic fields, and around 170 buildings including the French Revival-style Basilica.

landmarks.name: Main Building
landmarks.quote: The Main Building serves as the center for the university's administrative offices
landmarks.look: Administrative building topped by a golden dome and statue of Mary.

landmarks.name: Basilica of the Sacred Heart
landmarks.quote: The current Basilica of the Sacred Heart is on the site of Sorin's original church
landmarks.look: French Revival-style church with stained glass windows and a bell tower.

landmarks.name: Notre Dame Stadium
landmarks.quote: The most prominent is Notre Dame Stadium, home of the Fighting Irish football team
landmarks.look: Large football stadium seating over 80,000 people.

landmarks.name: Hesburgh Library
landmarks.quote: the Hesburgh Library with its Word of Life stone mural
landmarks.look: Library building featuring a prominent stone mural on its exterior.

landmarks.name: Main Quad
landmarks.quote: The main building is located on Main Quad (also known as "God Quad")
landmarks.look: Historic central quadrangle with greenery in front of the Main Building.

landmarks.name: Grotto of Our Lady of Lourdes
landmarks.name_en: Grotto of Our Lady of Lourdes
landmarks.quote: The Grotto of Our Lady of Lourdes, built in 1896
landmarks.look: Stone grotto replica of the shrine in Lourdes.

landmarks.name: Frank Eck Stadium
landmarks.quote: such as the Frank Eck Stadium for baseball.
